name: reinh-edit-kit
description: AI video editing kit: skills for coding agents, FFmpeg/Python scripts, editorial QC and a Remotion starter

scripts.sfx: node scripts/audio/sfx-synth-v1.mjs public/sfx/v1 && node scripts/audio/sfx-synth-v2.mjs public/sfx/v2 && node scripts/audio/sfx-synth-v3.mjs public/sfx/v3
scripts.render:example: remotion render Example out/example_preview.mp4 --scale=0.6666666666666666 && remotion render ExampleShort out/example_short_preview.mp4 --scale=0.6666666666666666
scripts.render:promo: remotion render Promo out/promo_mix_draft_720p.mp4 --scale=0.5 && remotion render Promo-Light out/promo_light_draft_720p.mp4 --scale=0.5 && remotion render Promo-Cine out/promo_cine_draft_720p.mp4 --scale=0.5
